background: Born and raised in Astoria, Queens, by Egyptian parents who remembered Muslim and Coptic neighbors sharing holiday food in Cairo.
regionalHistory: Her parents' stories of Nile evenings, storytelling grandmothers, and molokhia cooked for a whole stairwell shaped her Queens childhood.
culturalBaseline: Believes coexistence is ordinary, not exceptional; hospitality crosses every line.
communicationStyle: Vivid, animated, loves a good anecdote.
